queries_run: Himax Technologies export control entity list China trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: Himax 20-F 風險因子：產品／技術對部分客戶可能需額外 EAR 出口許可；若客戶或晶圓代工、封測供應商被列入 BIS Entity List，公司可能須暫停銷售或服務，並可能出貨延遲。
findings.excerpt: Extra export licenses may be needed for certain product or technology for certain customers. These licenses are regulated by Export Administration Regulations (EAR) which are administered by the U.S. Department of Commerce’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS).

findings.claim: Himax 20-F 風險因子：美國或他國可能對台灣公司產品課新關稅，並可能促使客戶將半導體供應鏈移出高地緣風險地區。
findings.excerpt: Changes in U.S. and international trade policies, including the possibility that new tariffs could be imposed by the U.S. or other countries on Taiwanese company products, may adversely impact our business and operating results.

findings.claim: FY2025 大尺寸驅動 IC 營收年減 28.0% 至 $90.7M，公司歸因於關稅與地緣不確定性等弱總體環境；中小尺寸年減 8.0% 至 $575.1M，智慧手機與平板受關稅相關不確定性影響。
findings.excerpt: Amid slowing end-market sell-through and tariff-related uncertainties, smartphone and tablet sales were particularly impacted.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 Himax 被列入 Entity List 或 Section 232 半導體關稅（2026-01-15 生效、範圍窄）直接涵蓋 Himax 產品的來源；未搜尋其餘兩題。
